description: Proposed 17-control test suite for dormant controller-to-child namespace connection

controls.scope: Pre/post-stage success for 5-member model (large/large-v3-turbo) including preprocessor_config.json and vocabulary.json
Refusal when foreign or copied startup/session/permit is supplied to stage validation
Refusal when release authority or runtime profile changes after startup consumption
Refusal when worker read set, child source sha256, or creation time is substituted or altered
Refusal when channel is independently constructed or master key is forged
Refusal when admitted envelope selection or profile does not match release or manifest
Refusal when envelope contains missing or extra member entries
Refusal when envelope member handles are aliased across distinct files
Refusal when physical identity (volume serial, file id) collides or is duplicated
Refusal when child adoption attempts buffer materialization before begin is accepted
Initial cancel releases unread adoption, sends closed frame, and completes without buffers materialized
Refusal when begin/cancel operations are replayed or submitted out of order
Refusal when an arbitrary, constructed, or copied lease or namespace attempts validation
Short read or digest mismatch retains partial chunks and preserves materialization exception
Revocation prior to lease publication retains materialized custody and raises publication revoked
Preservation of original failure exception when subsequent cleanup operations raise errors
Pre/post-stage success for 4-member model (tiny/base/small/medium with vocabulary.txt, no preprocessor_config.json)
